required_inputs_reviewed.finding: Participation is a return-pass loop: sync, reread changed inputs, inspect Issues and pull requests, review peers progressively, validate external sources, update the package and rerun preflight.
Keep the proposal directory authoritative, separate facts from assumptions, preserve professional and public-interest review boundaries, and validate before handoff.
The open call welcomes continuing, reviewable proposals; repository intake is not publication, selection, approval or endorsement.
Continuous participation requires upstream synchronization, peer review, repository collaboration, source provenance, a reviewable sharing draft and participant preflight.
Source status and allowed use must remain explicit; registered background material cannot replace primary evidence or official geometry.
Formal package structure, language metadata, evidence references and local gates remain binding for the return pass.
